summary: SiteDocument is a simple entity representing a document linked to a site, used to organize or reference documents by site identifier in the system.
purpose: To provide a structured association between documents and sites for storage, retrieval, and reference operations within the application.
content_gaps: No information about how documents are created, deleted, or updated.
No business rules or workflows described.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a web page/UI in the system, designed to display a welcome message, login information, and provide filters and controls for viewing student employment applications.
purpose: To present a welcome interface for staff administrators, show last login details and enable filtering/viewing submitted student employment applications by site, discipline, date range, and withdrawn status.

workflows.name: View Employment Applications
steps: User selects site and discipline from dropdowns.
User sets start and end date for filtering.
User can show/hide withdrawn applications with checkbox.
User clicks Refresh to update view.
Data is queried and displayed in grid (gvwApplications) with paging and custom formatting.
User can click to view details or email via links.

business_rules: Withdrawn applications are shown/hidden based on checkbox.
Start date and end date validations are enforced (required fields, date regular expression, custom validator for date order).
validations: RequiredFieldValidator: StartDate and EndDate must be provided.
RegularExpressionValidator: Dates must match expected format.
CustomValidator: StartDate must be before EndDate.
conditions: If ShowWithdrawn is checked, withdrawn applications are included.
system_behavior: RefreshView() triggers databinding and updates displayed applications.
Grid supports paging and custom formatting.
JavaScript used to manage field variables and client validation.
dependencies: Sites and Disciplines must be available for dropdown population.
UserSession information required for filtering, validation, and displaying personalized data.
exceptions: If session is missing, data queries are cancelled.
No data template shown if result set is empty.
content_gaps: No explicit description of how employment application data is retrieved.
No description of any authorization or security checks.
Some UI and workflow details may be inferred but are not fully described.

summary: ServiceCode defines code values used for categorizing and describing services, with support for localization and multiple retrieval methods by course or timetable.
purpose: To provide structured and localized code values for service categorization and retrieval in various contexts (all, course, timetable).

workflows.name: Retrieve Service Codes
steps: System executes stored procedures to get service codes for all, by course, or by timetable.
Returned data is localized based on session language setting.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is true in session, Name and Notes are replaced with NameAlt and NotesAlt.
conditions: UseAltLanguageFields controls which language fields are used.
system_behavior: Procedures are used for all retrieval operations.
Localization is dynamically applied based on session.
dependencies: Session controls language used and provides database access.
content_gaps: No information about how codes are added, updated, or deleted.

summary: SiteProfileHistory records actions performed on Site Profiles, including data changes, responsible users, agency information, and optional phone and formatted details.
purpose: To provide audit history for Site Profiles, capturing details of changes, affected fields, actors, and contextual agency/user information.

workflows.name: Search Site Profile History
steps: User triggers search for a Site Profile history.
System executes stored procedure with SiteID and SessionAgencyID.
Results returned and displayed; details formatted by helper properties.

business_rules: Formatting and display rules for names and agency details.
calculations: AgencyUserFormatted: Initials/agency codes, support team indicator.
conditions: SysAdmin/service team flags are used to distinguish actors.
system_behavior: Stored procedure returns history entries, helper functions format results.
dependencies: Session provides language mode and phone formatting.
exceptions: Query is cancelled if session is absent.
content_gaps: Details of UI display, retrieval triggers, and actor permissions missing.

summary: EmailPopupDocument represents files/documents presented in email popups. Supports searching and deletion by manipulating file paths and directory structure.
purpose: To manage and display documents in the context of email popups, including logical operations for searching and deleting files.

workflows.name: Search Email Popup Documents
steps: System parses DataInfo input, splits by delimiter.
Populates EmailPopupDocument entities and returns to caller.

workflows.name: Delete Email Popup Document
steps: System identifies folder and file from input.
Attempts file deletion; if successful, deletes directory.
Removes file entry from DataInfo.

business_rules: File and directory deletion attempted, errors caught silently.
conditions: Delete only if folder/file found and parsed correctly.
system_behavior: Search creates list of documents from string input.
Delete removes file from storage and DataInfo.
dependencies: Relies on valid file path and directory structure.
exceptions: File/Directory deletion errors are caught and ignored.
content_gaps: No security or permission checks described.

summary: ExpenseBatch represents batches of expenses grouped by department and managed via add, search, update, and delete workflows.
purpose: To organize, track, and update batches of department expenses for reporting and processing.

workflows.name: Search Expense Batches
steps: Stored procedure retrieves batches for department.
Returns list of batches with formatted number and status.

workflows.name: Add ExpenseBatch
steps: Executes DB procedure with session, department ID, description, and date.
Returns new batch ID.

workflows.name: Update ExpenseBatch
steps: Executes DB procedure for update with new values.

workflows.name: Delete ExpenseBatch
steps: Executes DB procedure to delete batch by ID.

business_rules: Status description uses alt-language option if enabled.
calculations: BatchNumberFormatted: combination of ID and status.
system_behavior: Procedures support batch lifecycle: search, add, update, delete.
dependencies: Session provides language and DB access.
content_gaps: No user or UI context provided.
No explicit permission or security checks.
